sourceRef: Sage Payroll Tax Pocket Guide 2025-2026 s7.12.2 (X = A x B - C)
notes: Salary R30 000 = retirement-funding income (B); fund member category factor 0.12 (A, from the fund); employee contribution 7.5% = 2 250 (C, 4001). Fringe benefit X = 0.12 x 30 000 - 2 250 = 1 350 (non-cash, deemed contributed by the employee). Remuneration 31 350; fund contributions 2 250 + 1 350 = 3 600, under 27.5% x 31 350 = 8 621.25, so all deductible; taxable 27 750 x 12 = 333 000: 44 118 + 26% x 87 900 = 66 972 - 17 820 = 49 152 / 12 = 4 096.00. SDL 1% x 27 750 = 277.50. Net 30 000 - 2 250 - 4 096 - 177.12 = 23 476.88. UNVERIFIED: the formula is read from Sage\’s pocket guide, not a SARS 2027 page (G21 has no para 12D section).
